description: Header file defining a JSON parser class (JSONReader) with parsing options, error handling, and related enums and constants, used for converting JSON strings into Value objects.

classes.name: JSONReader
classes.description: Class providing static and instance methods for parsing JSON strings into Value objects, with error handling and configuration options.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Static method to parse a JSON string into a Value object, returning nullptr on failure.

methods.name: ReadAndReturnError
methods.description: Static method to parse JSON with detailed error reporting via output parameters.

methods.name: ErrorCodeToString
methods.description: Converts a parse error code into a human-readable message.

methods.name: ReadToValue
methods.description: Instance method to parse JSON string into a Value object.

methods.name: error_code
methods.description: Returns the last parse error code.

methods.name: GetErrorMessage
methods.description: Returns a human-readable message for the last error, including location info.
